Mattermost.note: Brand name; never translate. Compounds take a hyphen: 'Mattermost-serveren', 'Mattermost-teamet'.

Enterprise Edition.note: Keep in English. The legacy 'Enterprise versjon' (about.teamEditiont1) is not to be followed.

Team Edition.note: Keep in English. The legacy 'Team versjon' (about.teamEditiont0) is not to be followed.

Mattermost Cloud.note: Keep in English. Do not render 'Cloud' as 'Sky' (about.cloudEdition does; legacy).

Channels.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'channels' is 'kanaler'.

Playbooks.note: Product name. A single playbook as common noun stays 'playbook' (en playbook, playbooken).

Calls.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'call' is 'samtale'.

LDAP.note: 'AD/LDAP' stays as-is; compounds take a hyphen: 'AD/LDAP-brukernavn'.

MFA.note: Spelled out as 'flerfaktorautentisering' where the English spells it out.

System Console.note: Masculine: systemkonsollen (definite). The catalog has a few 'systemkonsollet' and three untranslated 'System Console' — do not follow those.

marketplace.note: The existing catalog keeps 'Marketplace' in English everywhere (admin.plugins.settings.*). Keep it, capitalised, as the name of the plugin store.

channel.note: Masculine: en kanal, kanalen, kanaler, kanalene.

team.note: Neuter: et team, teamet, team, teamene. Compounds: 'teamnavn', 'teaminnstillinger'.

post.note: Neuter: et innlegg, innlegget. 'melding' is also widely used where the English says post; both appear in the catalog. Prefer 'melding' in user-facing message-list strings and 'innlegg' in admin/permission strings, matching the surrounding keys.

thread.note: Masculine: en tråd, tråden, tråder. The Threads view is 'Tråder'.

reply.note: Neuter: et svar, svaret, svar. Verb: svare ('Svar' as button).

direct message.note: One word. Two legacy strings have 'direkte melding' — do not follow. 'DM' is not used in the Norwegian UI; spell it out.

mention.note: Noun: omtale, omtaler ('Siste omtaler'). Verb: nevne ('@nevne'); 'omtale' as verb is also fine.

notification.note: Neuter: et varsel, varselet, varsler. 'varsling' for the activity/setting ('varslingsinnstillinger').

pin.note: Pinned messages = 'Festede meldinger'; 'Fest til kanal'; unpin = 'Løsne' ('Løsne fra kanalen').

bookmark.note: Neuter: et bokmerke, bokmerket, bokmerker. Verb: 'legg til bokmerke'.

saved messages.note: save = lagre; unsave = 'Opphev lagring' / 'Fjern fra lagrede'. Legacy 'Fjern fra Lagrer' is a typo — do not follow.

draft.note: Neuter: et utkast, utkastet, utkast, utkastene.

scheduled post.note: Tab heading is 'Planlagt'; the catalog mixes 'planlagt innlegg' and 'planlagte utkast'. Prefer 'planlagt melding' / 'planlagte meldinger'.

emoji.note: Masculine: en emoji, emojien, emojier. Compounds hyphenated: 'emoji-velger'.

do not disturb.note: Status label. 'DND' is not used in the Norwegian UI.

online.note: Majority rendering ('Sist pålogget'); one aria string leaves 'Online' untranslated — do not follow.

out of office.note: Menu label (userAccountMenu.oooMenuItem). The catalog also has 'Fraværende' (manual-status modal) and 'Ute av kontoret'; prefer 'Ikke på kontoret'.

guest.note: Masculine: en gjest, gjesten, gjester. Guest access = 'gjestetilgang'.

system admin.note: Plural 'systemadministratorer'. Short 'systemadmin' appears twice; prefer the full form.

team admin.note: One word. The legacy 'Team administrator' (user_profile.roleTitle.team_admin) is wrong.

session.note: Masculine: en sesjon, sesjonen, sesjoner. Not 'økt'.

sign in.note: Button 'Logg inn'; noun 'innlogging' / 'pålogging'. Both 'sign in' and 'log in' = logge inn. The catalog also uses 'logg på' about as often; prefer 'logg inn'. Informal 'du' register.

sign out.note: Button 'Logg ut'. Both 'sign out' and 'log out' = logge ut.

join.note: 'Bli med i kanalen', 'bli med i teamet'. 'joined' = 'ble med'.

unarchive.note: Button 'Gjenopprett fra arkiv' (channel_info_rhs.archived.unarchive). Avoid 'dearkivere' (one legacy string) and 'reaktiver'.

mute.note: 'Demp kanal'; unmute = 'Fjern demping'. Same verb for microphone mute in Calls.

favorite.note: Sidebar category 'Favoritter'. Verb: 'Legg til i favoritter'; unfavorite: 'Fjern fra favoritter'.

webhook.note: Kept in English; definite form hyphenated 'webhook-en', plural 'webhooks'/'webhook-er' — prefer 'webhooks'.

trigger word.note: Majority rendering; 'utløserord' and 'aktiveringsord' appear once each — do not follow.

plugin.note: Kept in English; plural 'plugins', definite 'pluginen'/'pluginene'. Not 'programtillegg'.

bot.note: Masculine: en bot, boten, boter. Bot account = 'botkonto'.

scheme.note: Permission scheme = 'tillatelsesskjema'; team scheme = 'teamskjema'. A legacy string uses 'teamplan' — do not follow.

trial.note: Majority rendering; 'prøveversjon' appears when the software itself is meant. Free trial = 'gratis prøveperiode'.

invite.note: Verb; button 'Inviter'. As a noun use 'invitasjon'.

public channel.note: Established rendering (plural 'åpne kanaler'); 'offentlig kanal' is not used in the catalog.

recap.note: No established rendering in the catalog; use 'oppsummering' (plural 'oppsummeringer') for the entity and 'oppsummere' for the action.

agent.note: Masculine: en agent, agenten, agenter. 'AI agent' = 'KI-agent'; the product 'Mattermost Agents' stays in English.

burn-on-read.note: No existing rendering in the catalog; keep the feature name in English and compound with a hyphen ('Burn-on-Read-melding'). Do not translate literally ('brenn ved lesing').

magic link.note: The existing catalog keeps 'Magic Link' in English (user.settings.security.*).

personal access token.note: Neuter: tilgangstokenet, plural 'tilgangstokener'. Permission strings use 'brukertilgangstoken' for 'user access token'.

channel banner.note: Neuter: kanalbanneret. Form labels use 'Bannertekst', 'Farge på banner'.

keyword.note: Notification settings also use 'søkeord' once — prefer 'nøkkelord'.

collapsed reply threads.note: Established feature name (user.settings.display, admin.experimental). Do not render literally ('sammenslåtte svartråder').

data retention.note: Policy = 'policy for dataoppbevaring' (the catalog uses 'policy', not 'retningslinje', throughout admin strings).

access control.note: Attribute-based access control = 'attributtbasert tilgangskontroll'; policy = 'policy for tilgangskontroll'.

attribute.note: Neuter: et attributt, attributtet, attributter. Custom profile attribute = 'egendefinert profilattributt'.

onboarding.note: Kept in English in the catalog ('onboardingprosessen'). Where a plain Norwegian phrase fits better, 'komme i gang' is acceptable.

Town Square.note: Default channel name; no rendering exists yet in either catalog (server entries are empty). Use consistently.

Off-Topic.note: Default channel name; no rendering exists yet in either catalog. Use consistently.

server.note: Masculine: en server, serveren, servere. Not 'tjener'.
